title: gcmc params.json
description: Input template for a GCMC run or sweep. Pass to `python -m gcmc run` for one run, or to `python -m gcmc.launcher` for a sweep. For sweeps, set ensemble.mu, sampler.trial_density, and/or sampler.trial_box_side to a LIST; the launcher takes the Cartesian product (two lists = a heatmap). Every other field stays scalar. Ensembles: muVT (grand canonical), NVT (canonical, repacking), QA (quenched-annealed fluid in a frozen matrix; set ensemble.type='QA' and run.matrix_config).

main.description: hard_core: athermal exclusion. lennard_jones: requires T.

T.description: Reduced temperature T*; required iff main == lennard_jones, forbidden otherwise.

tail.description: LJ long-range tail correction; lennard_jones only.

auxiliary.description: OPTIONAL. Omit for no auxiliary (pure main potential). pmf adds a g3 selection bias that divides out of the density.

g3_csv.description: Path to the g3 table; required in 3D.

eta.description: 2D analytic g(r) packing fraction (2D pmf only).

type.description: metropolis: single-particle. rosenbluth/branch: cavity-biased insertion (depth 0-3). channel: oriented-cuboid transfer-matrix sweep (3D, serial, depth >= 1 unless full_repacking). reweight: 2D hexatic.

depth.description: Cavity recursion depth; forbidden for metropolis. Validated 0-3. Mutually exclusive with full_repacking.

full_repacking.description: XOR alternative to depth: repack the whole cavity each exchange, removing every sphere found and inserting one more (add), one fewer (remove), or the same count (repack). Ignores depth; do not give both. Cavity samplers only (not metropolis).

channel_length.description: channel only: length of the long axis of the oriented trial cuboid.

channel_width.description: channel only: side of the square cross-section, required in [sigma, 2 sigma]. The trial cuboid volume is channel_length * channel_width^2.

trials.description: Fixed trial count per cavity. Mutually exclusive with trial_density; forbidden for metropolis.

trial_density.description: Trial count set by density x trial-box span. Forbidden for metropolis. SWEEPABLE: a list builds one run per value.

trial_box_side.description: rosenbluth/branch only: full side of the square trial box (twice the legacy cavity radius). Forbidden for metropolis and rejected for channel (which uses channel_length/channel_width with trial_density). SWEEPABLE: a list builds one run per value (pair with trial_density for a heatmap).

mu.description: Chemical potential mu* (TOTAL: activity z = exp(beta*mu)). REQUIRED for muVT and QA; forbidden for NVT. QA may use mu < 0. SWEEPABLE: a list builds one run per value. With a target, mu is an OPTIONAL starting seed (default: the ideal-gas guess ln(rho_target)).

sweep.description: Legacy mu sweep list; prefer a list under ensemble.mu.

type.description: muVT: grand canonical (give mu). NVT: canonical (give exactly one of N or packing_fraction, no mu). QA: quenched-annealed = muVT in a frozen matrix (give mu AND run.matrix_config; mu may be < 0 for the dilute isotherm). confined: grand canonical in a hard slit or cylinder pore (give mu and ensemble.pore; 3D only; no matrix).

pore.description: confined only: a hard wall inside the periodic box. slit walls sit at z=0 and z=H; a cylinder of radius R runs along z through the centre. Every gap must admit a whole sphere (2*radius).

H.description: slit gap in z; must exceed the diameter and stay below box - diameter.

R.description: cylinder radius; 2R must exceed the diameter and stay below box - diameter.

N.description: NVT only: exact particle count, held fixed by repacking. SWEEPABLE. Mutually exclusive with packing_fraction.

packing_fraction.description: NVT only: converted to nearest integer N = round(eta * V / v_particle), then held exactly. SWEEPABLE.

target_eta.description: muVT target control: drive mu until the running-mean packing fraction reaches this value. Mutually exclusive with mu(sweep) and the other targets. SWEEPABLE: a list runs one job per value (launch with gcmc.launcher). When swept against a matrix FOLDER, each value is paired by index with one realization matrix.

target_density.description: muVT target control: drive mu until the running-mean reduced density rho*=N/V reaches this value. SWEEPABLE: a list runs one job per value (launch with gcmc.launcher). When swept against a matrix FOLDER, each value is paired by index with one realization matrix.

target_N.description: muVT target control: drive mu until the running-mean particle count <N> reaches this value. SWEEPABLE: a list runs one job per value (launch with gcmc.launcher). When swept against a matrix FOLDER, each value is paired by index with one realization matrix.

kind.description: single: one serial chain (1 core). parallel: cell-decomposed (uses n_workers cores).

n_cores.description: REQUIRED. Total cores available this job. The launcher refuses to start if (number of sweep combinations) x (cores per run) exceeds this. cores-per-run = n_workers if parallel else 1. Can be overridden on the CLI with --cores.

n_workers.description: Worker processes for a parallel run; this is the per-run core cost. Required iff kind == parallel.

cell_length.description: Parallel cell side; must exceed 2 x cavity radius. >= 10 cavity widths recommended for depth >= 1 (approximate mode).

buffer.description: Frozen-border width; must be >= interaction range (rc for LJ, diameter for hard core).

traj_every.description: Trajectory saving. 0 (default) = save ONLY the last frame (one overwritten snapshot in trajectory.extxyz). N >= 1 = append every N-th window's configuration to a growing trajectory (N=1 saves every window). Use traj_every=1 for QA RDF runs, which need every frame. On resume, an append-mode trajectory is trimmed to the checkpoint step so frames are never duplicated.

initial_config.description: Starting configuration; omit to start fresh (bulk muVT starts empty, NVT/QA/confined seed a valid start). Two forms. (1) A path to a single file: extended-XYZ (atom-count line, a Lattice/Properties comment, then `species x y z` rows) or a bare `x y z` float table; the first line decides which. (2) A path to the equilibrated library directory, nested by system, temperature (LJ only) and box, e.g. lj/T_0.85/box_20/mu_0.0_lj_3d_box20.xyz or hard_disk_2d/box_200/mu_1.00_hard_2d_box_200.xyz. The per-run file is found by matching chemical potential, box, dimension and (for LJ) temperature, tolerant of the differing decimal and box_<L> vs box<L> filename styles. A run raises if nothing matches (it lists what is present) or if several match (it lists the candidates).

radius.description: Particle radius (diameter = 2 x radius = LJ sigma).

matrix_config.description: REQUIRED iff ensemble.type='QA'; forbidden otherwise. Absolute path to the frozen matrix configuration (an NVT checkpoint.npz, an extended-XYZ .xyz/.extxyz, or a plain 'x y z' file). The fluid cannot overlap these obstacles, which are never inserted/deleted/moved/counted. The matrix content is folded into the run-id hash (distinct realizations -> distinct dirs) and snapshotted into the run directory as matrix.npz, so a resume is self-contained even if the source file moves. QA supports hard_core or LJ+branch, sampler rosenbluth/branch, and run.kind='single' only. May also be a FOLDER of realizations (subdirs each with trajectory.extxyz or checkpoint.npz, or a flat folder of *.xyz/*.extxyz/*.npz): then a list target sweep pairs each swept value with one matrix by sorted index (16 targets -> 16 matrices -> 16 runs). The last frame of each trajectory is used. A folder is only valid via gcmc.launcher, not a single `gcmc run`.

control_gain.description: Robbins-Monro gain for muVT target control: mu += gain/(1+win/gain_tau) * (ln N_target - ln <N>) per window.

control_gain_tau.description: Decay scale (in windows) of the target-control gain; larger = slower decay, more aggressive late correction.

control_window.description: Number of windows in the running mean of N that the target controller steers (and reports as avgN).
